title: A Time to Kill
author: John Grisham
summary: In a small Mississippi town, a Black father shoots the two white men who brutally attacked his young daughter. A struggling local lawyer takes the case, in a place that is ready to explode.
readIf: you like courtroom drama set in a pressure-cooker small town that wrestles with justice and prejudice.
skipIf: you want to avoid a graphic attack on a child and frequent racist language, which are central to the story.

pairings.reason: The classic Southern courtroom story of race and justice that this book is in conversation with.
Another novel set in the segregated South with a focus on personal courage and uncomfortable history.
A more intricate, more thoughtful courtroom novel about guilt and who gets to decide it.
